recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is for FHIR-51229. Treat any broader clarification of DeviceAssociation status/statusReason/associationStatus semantics as follow-up under a final issue such as FHIR-54463, and treat residual DeviceAssociation.operation cleanup as part of the separate operation-removal issue family.
issue_request: FHIR-51229 was Applied as Persuasive with Modification for R6 after reporting that DeviceAssociation.status was 1..1 with a required binding that mixed resource-record state and physical association lifecycle values, leaving no clear code for detached or ended associations. Its resolution says to use FHIR-48532, which pre-applied the separation of status from other association status values.
initial_application: No source commit mentioning FHIR-51229 was found. The relevant application is FHIR-48532 commit 2b906e8ba0, which changed DeviceAssociation.status to a required code value set of active, inactive, entered-in-error, and unknown; made statusReason extensible; and added DeviceAssociation.associationStatus. FHIR-48713 commit f09755d231 then added the abandoned associationStatus code.
additional_context: DeviceAssociation is active in source/fhir.ini. OO 2025-10-24 minutes list FHIR-51229 with FHIR-48532, mark it Persuasive with Modification and pre-applied, and note possible future questions about the interplay between status, statusReason, and associationStatus. Later FHIR-54463 is Triaged and asks for broader quality review, so it is not a final source-edit decision for this reconciliation.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. No source hunk was needed because the current StructureDefinition and terminology sources already keep record status in DeviceAssociation.status, relax statusReason to extensible, and move physical/operational association states into optional preferred associationStatus.
